# Joan Bono Frígols — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Joan Bono Frígols, a Software Developer specialized in
> Android, Kotlin Multiplatform and AI integration. The site is available in
> Spanish (default) and English, and is fully static (server-rendered HTML),
> so all content is readable without executing JavaScript.

## About
- Name: Joan Bono Frígols
- Role: Android & Kotlin Multiplatform Developer | AI Integrator
- Location: Valencia, Spain
- Focus: Java, Kotlin, Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, Generative AI, AI integration, Clean Architecture, relational databases, Git.

## Pages
- [Home (Spanish)](https://joanbonoprog.es/): Main portfolio — hero, about, education, projects, experience, skills and contact.
- [Home (English)](https://joanbonoprog.es/en/): English version of the portfolio.

## Sections
- About: professional profile and continuous learning.
- Education: academic background (Evolve Academy, IFP Formación).
- Projects: featured work including "App Prototype Creator" and "Live Football", with image galleries and source links.
- Experience: professional roles and collaborations.
- Skills: technologies and proficiency levels.
- Contact: email, phone, LinkedIn and GitHub.
